Jordan: Hey team — odd timing, sorry. Flight out of LHR is delayed and I'm not going to make my EU night primary shift (02:00-06:00 UTC). I already started triage on the embeddings latency issue in eu-west1 (brief context below). I need someone to pick up primary and own the bridge/pages for that window. If you can, please reply 'I'll take' and set your Slack status + update the oncall tool. Sorry for the last-minute ask.

oncall-bot: Rotations: primary=jordan, secondary=Miho. Active PD incident: PD-EMB-2345. To claim primary quickly: `@oncall-bot claim primary` (or update PagerDuty and set Slack status).

Miho: I can split shift — I can cover 02:00-03:00 and 03:45-06:00 (have a dentist appt 03:00-03:45). If someone can take 03:00-03:45 short gap I'll pick up the bridge before and after. @Ravi any chance you can cover the 45m?

Ravi: I'll take 03:00-03:45. I'll be reachable by phone. I'll also watch the bridging channel until Priya/jordan confirm. I'll post once I add myself to the PD incident. I'll take. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Thanks both — below is the quick runbook snippet for embeddings latency (what I was about to run if pages spike):
```
# check model worker pods in eu-west1
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-worker -o wide
# tail logs for high 99th latency requests
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed-worker -c worker --since=5m | rg "latency" -n
# check KV cache hitrate + redis
redis-cli -h redis-eu-master INFO stats | rg keyspace
# quick mitigation: rollback to lower-concurrency config
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/embed-frontend MAX_CONCURRENCY=8
```
(Also check the autoscaler metric `embed_queue_length` in the Console and the cache hitrate dashboard — low hitrate often explains tokenized fetch spikes.)

incident-bot: Incident EMB-2345 — status: triage. Impact: ~5% requests in eu-west1 >800ms, affected customers: search-indexers, internal-prod-chat. Bridge: https://call.example.com/emb-2345 (open). Runbook: https://playbooks.internal/embeddings-latency.

Priya: I can take full 02:00-06:00 primary if that helps (I have minimal meetings). Happy to own the bridge and escalate to infra if it looks like autoscaler stuck. If others already split, I can still be secondary/backup — let me know which you prefer.

Miho: @Priya that's amazing — if you can take full 02:00-06:00 that removes the gap. I can shadow and take over the post-incident follow-ups.

Ravi: Confirmed I've added myself to PD-EMB-2345 as a deputy for 03:00-03:45.

Priya: I'll take primary 02:00-06:00. Steps I'm doing now: 1) set Slack status "Oncall — primary (02:00-06:00 UTC)", 2) claim primary with oncall-bot, 3) join bridge and pin runbook. Please DM me any short notes, Jordan.

Jordan: Thank you Priya, Miho, Ravi. I'll DM transfer notes (keys and where I left logs). Couple of final notes: Winter festival traffic expected in eu-west1 overnight (marketing spike), keep an eye on autoscaler and the `embed_queue_length` threshold alerts. Handoff checklist (quick):
- set Slack status + claim primary
- join bridge and pin runbook
- confirm PD assignment and add yourself to incident chat
- check cache hitrate, model worker counts, and recent deploys
- if more than 10% of requests exceed 800ms escalate to infra (pager infra oncall)

Priya: Got it. I've set status, claimed primary via oncall-bot, joined bridge, and I'm on PD-EMB-2345. Catching up on Jordan's notes now.

Jordan: Appreciate it — logging out now to sort rebooking. If anything urgent before 02:00 ping me but otherwise I'm handing off. :pray:
